extracted.intended_audience: aspiring fiction writers, especially speculative/fantasy authors
extracted.subtask_description: Practical craft and professional advice for writers creating speculative (fantasy/science fiction) stories, covering philosophy, techniques, thematic choices, and career mindset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write Diverse Stories
rubrics_metrics.description: "Write Diverse Stories — 'It's human nature that we come in our own flavours.'"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages exploring varied perspectives, characters, and experiences rather than repeating a single voice or type of story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write Observable Truth
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction must be "true" by exploring universal human experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize emotional or experiential truth—make scenes and characters resonate as authentic even within speculative contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embrace Discomfort
rubrics_metrics.description: Compelling stories place protagonists in peril.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Put characters under pressure or threat; conflict and stakes create engagement and narrative drive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Break the Rules Knowingly
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn conventions before subverting them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study craft and genre expectations first so that any rule-breaking is deliberate and meaningful rather than accidental or naive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize Wonder
rubrics_metrics.description: Magic should inspire awe; never mundane despite prevalence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if many characters or worlds are familiar with fantastical elements, present them in ways that restore a sense of wonder to the reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test Different Approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Write sample chapters in various tenses and viewpoints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experiment with narrative voice, tense, and perspective to find the most effective framing for a story; use trial drafts to compare options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Don't Over-Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Research informs but shouldn't overwhelm composition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gather necessary factual/contextual material, but avoid letting research stall writing; keep nonessential details for notes rather than the manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show Only Relevant Details
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep other research in notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include only details that serve character, theme, or plot; remove or archive interesting but irrelevant facts to preserve narrative focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find Your Natural Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Plotters and discovery writers both work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize whether you prefer outlining or discovery writing and adopt a process that suits you rather than copying someone else's workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write from Beginning and End
rubrics_metrics.description: Start knowing opening and conclusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Having a clear sense of both the story's opening hook and its ending helps maintain direction and thematic coherence during drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek Human Connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Artists need contact with people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain relationships and interactions outside solitary writing to sustain empathy, perspective, and emotional resources for storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define Success Personally
rubrics_metrics.description: Not bestseller status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set personal benchmarks of success (craft growth, connection with readers, sustained practice) rather than only external metrics like sales or fame.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write for Yourself First
rubrics_metrics.description: Authentic work attracts true fans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize making work that satisfies you artistically; being authentic increases the chance of attracting readers who genuinely appreciate your voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice Persistently
rubrics_metrics.description: Skill develops through repetition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent writing and revising over time are necessary to improve craft; persistence beats one-off effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept Imperfect Beginnings
rubrics_metrics.description: Early unpublishable work is normal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow yourself to write bad or unfinished early drafts as part of the learning process; don't expect first attempts to be polished.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage Writing Anxiety
rubrics_metrics.description: Nervousness indicates novelty; push through.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize anxiety as a signal that you're doing something new and use it as motivation rather than a barrier to productivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Persist Through Doubt
rubrics_metrics.description: "If you're not good enough yet, work harder."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respond to self-doubt with disciplined effort and practice rather than quitting; improvement is achievable through sustained work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Challenge Conservative Structures
rubrics_metrics.description: Epic fantasy traditionally restores status quo; subvert.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be mindful of genre conventions that reinforce existing power structures and consider ways to undermine or reframe them in your work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combat Reactionary Thinking
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustaining reactive movements requires new targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize and resist simplistic or reactionary narratives; craft stories that interrogate rather than reinforce harmful ideological cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster Connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Help readers feel less isolated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to create empathy and shared experience through characters and themes so readers can feel seen and understood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Celebrate Dreaming
rubrics_metrics.description: Remind adult readers imagination is valid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use speculative elements to reawaken wonder and the value of imaginative thinking for mature audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be Authentically Transgressive
rubrics_metrics.description: Permission to be unusual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don't shy away from being unconventional or challenging norms when it serves the story's truth and integrity; authenticity is the safeguard against gratuitous provocation.
